question:
(i) Explain the meaning of dielectric constant in terms of reduction of electric field inside a dielectric.
(ii) An external electric field of magnitude $9 \times 10^4\text{ N C}^{-1}$ is applied to a dielectric. The net electric field inside it becomes $3 \times 10^4\text{ N C}^{-1}$. Find the dielectric constant and the magnitude of the induced electric field.

options.A:
(i) $K=\frac{E}{E_0}$ because dielectric increases the field.
(ii) $K=\frac{1}{3}$ and induced field is $1.2\times10^5\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
options.B:
(i) $K=\frac{E_0}{E}$ but the induced field has the same direction as the applied field.
(ii) $K=3$ and induced field is $6\times10^4\,\text{N C}^{-1}$ in the same direction
options.C:
(i) $K=\frac{E_0}{E}$ and dielectric has no induced field.
(ii) $K=3$ and induced field is zero
options.D:
(i) Dielectric polarisation produces an opposing induced field, so $K=\frac{E_0}{E}$.
(ii) $K=3$ and $E_{\text{induced}}=E_0-E=6\times10^4\,\text{N C}^{-1}$ opposite to the applied field
